title: Why Penalties Are 12 Yards
coreQuestion: Why is the penalty spot 12 yards from goal?

facts.claim: William McCrum, an Irish linen manufacturer, is most famous as the inventor of the penalty kick.
The original penalty-kick law dates from 1891.
The penalty spot was introduced, 12 yards from the goal.
The first penalty kick in a match was taken and scored by Billy Heath of Wolves.

narration.text: Why is a penalty taken from 12 yards?
The idea came from William McCrum, an Irish linen manufacturer.
In 1891, the penalty kick entered the laws of the game.
Then a penalty spot was introduced, 12 yards from the goal.
Billy Heath of Wolves scored the first. Every goal has a story.
